reviews.title: Did Bible Chat just become a cash grab???
reviews.text:
I am very disappointed with the updates to Bible Chat. Upon opening it this morning, I discovered the layout and the process are completely different. I know that apps these days are about changing--more than actually improving--for the sake of appearing to customers that their subscription money is being well spent. It is questionable whether that is the case with these revisions, but they are different, not necessarily worse.

However, once I got to the completion at the end of today's devotional, it showed that I had missed the last two days. So, I attempted to complete them as I have many times in the past. BUT, even though I have an annual subscription, the app tried to charge me $2.99 just to go back two days. And basically everything that shows on the screen at that point is about getting more money. It is like looking at a game screen where they are trying to get you to pay more to keep playing.

This is very, VERY disappointing for this app and its supposed purpose. It makes me wonder if this was the goal all along; getting followers of Jesus hooked on feeling better about our relationship with Him, but them not truly serving Him as a company. Was it always going to be about jacking up the price and making more money by gouging the user???

reviews.title: Every update just gets worse
reviews.text: When I first downloaded this app I really liked Bible Chat but an update messed with the Chat features that I really enjoyed. The latest update configured the app to two main groups: bible teachings and topical teachings. I chose the Bible camp. But the app would not let me complete that option. The button was faded but open for topical. Went in every day and tried to bypass the choice- as I did not want topical. I could not get in. Reached out to the app developers - no response. Chose Topical teachings just to get into the app and now I am stuck in these topical journeys that I do not want - having to bypass several screens just to get to the Bible or Chat. It is annoying. Loved this app but do not like being pigeon holed into options I do not want that I have to navigate thru in order to get to what I need - the Bible. Too much clutter and mandated topics they want you on. Bible Chat is testing the fruits of my spirit. An every day reminder to exercise my patience with this platform. Thank you Lord for reminding me I have lots of patience to learn every time I open this thing. SMH
